title: T12 partition setup only covers y2026m05, post-apply inserts for other months would fail
description: paper_v2_fill and factor_value are partitioned by trade_date but T12 only declared y2026m05 child partitions. Batch A imported 121 paper_v2 runs and 8243 fills from real history spanning multiple months, so post-apply archive inserts for other months would fail with 'no partition for row'. Fix: added DEFAULT partition for both paper_v2_fill_default and factor_value_default to absorb all out-of-range rows. pg_partman setup remains as later production automation. P1.5 of Codex T12+T14a review.
reproduce_command: psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5433 -d aistock_dev -f backend/db/init_qe_archive_paper_v2_extension_20260510.sql && python -c "# attempt insert with trade_date='2026-04-15'"
required_verification: Codex independent re-review of round-2 fix
post-apply smoke: archive Batch A real history (8243 fills across multiple months) without partition errors
closure_requirements: T12 dev DB apply succeeds + Batch A archive smoke green
Production rollout plan replaces DEFAULT with pg_partman-managed monthly partitions
